findings.title: Fair-balance deficiency — efficacy without safety context
findings.detail: The primary PFS claim (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.48–0.77; p<0.001) is presented without an accompanying safety statement. SmPC v2.1 §4.8 must be cited in proximity to any primary efficacy claim in materials governed by the ABPI Code 2023 §6.1 and IFPMA Code §5.2.

findings.title: Comparative claim without head-to-head data
findings.detail: The phrase 'fewer discontinuations than any comparator in first-line NSCLC' implies a cross-trial comparison that is not supported by the approved label (SmPC v2.1) or any cited publication. EFPIA Code 2022 Article 7 prohibits comparative claims unless based on direct head-to-head studies or clearly referenced indirect analyses.
